newsitem.title: UK: Danka says in talks on substantial buy.
newsitem.headline: Danka says in talks on substantial buy.

text.p: Danka Business Systems Plc said on Monday it is involved in talks "in connnection with a possible substantial acquisition".
The group said in a statement that the acquisition would not involve the issue of equity and a further announcement, "will follow in due course".
Danka said the announcement followed recent press reports.
On Friday the Wall Street Journal reported that Eastman Kodak Co and Danka were discussing the sale of part of Kodak's copier business.

The paper said one possibility was for Danka to buy Kodak's customer-service and distribution organisation for about $750 million. It said Danka earns about 80 percent of its revenue from servicing copiers.
Buying Kodak's copier service and distribution business would double Danka's client list, the paper said.
Danka shares were quoted 7-1/2p higher at 482-1/2.
